title: 骑手

series.next: In the oldest photo, the club's first president is holding 包子. The same cat.

setting: The university campus, Chengdu, 11:40 pm. Someone has seen a headless rider by the lake.

zhong.name: 小钟
zhong.en: revising for 考研, even now

qishou.name: 骑手
qishou.en: a shape in a black hood, head down

chase.name: 骑手
chase.en: the rider, pulling away towards the lake

caught.narr: The rider reaches the lake path, and the dark takes it.

caught.en: Gone. Just tyre tracks, and the lake. Run that back. 🛵

else.narr: 白老师 has lent the club the library's big torch.

else.en: With a light, I'm not scared!

steps.narr: 11:40 pm. By the canteen: a shape on an e-bike. Black, hunched over, and no head.
Four shared bikes. Scan, unlock, go.

say.tip: 站住 zhànzhù = stop (where you are)! 别跑 = don't run.

ok.narr: It hears you. It goes faster.

3.gloss: You, up ahead! Stop! Stop running!

steps.narr: 阿乐 is looking at the rider, not the road. A speed bump.

say.tip: 小心 xiǎoxīn = careful, look out!

ok.en: I'm fine... you lot go on!

fail.en: I'm fine... you lot go on!

answers: 阿乐，小心前面！有减速带！
阿乐小心，前面有减速带！
3.gloss: 阿乐, look out ahead! Speed bump!

steps.narr: The night library has just closed. A hundred students, coming down the steps.

say.tip: 同学 tóngxué = classmate: what students call each other.

answers: 不好意思，同学们，借过一下！
不好意思同学们，借过一下！

steps.narr: A corner. The rider is gone. Smoke from a barbecue stall.

say.en: Ask the stall owner if he saw someone on a bike.
say.gloss: Did you see someone on a bike?
say.tip: 看见 kànjiàn = see. 骑车的 = someone riding a bike.

ok.en: The lake! Went towards the lake!

answers: 看见骑车的往哪儿去了吗？
您看见骑车的往哪儿去了吗？
3.gloss: Did you see which way the rider went?

steps.narr: The lake. The rider has stopped under a lamp, head down, hood up.
Not headless: a courier in a black hood, reading a phone.

steps.en: The sender said: deliver at night.

say.en: Open it now, or take it to 阿乐 first.
say.tip: 打开看看 = open it and see: a verb, then 看看 for a look.

ok.narr: Photos. Dozens. The club room, twenty years ago: the same sign, the same broken chair.

ok.en: They're all from twenty years ago...

alts.en: Or: take it to 阿乐 first

then.narr: Back at the club room, 阿乐, one knee grazed, opens it with shaking hands.

then.en: ...This is our club. Twenty years ago.

answers: 等不及了，现在就打开看看！
3.gloss: I can't wait. Let's open it right now!

answers: 这是大家的，先拿给阿乐看。
alts.gloss: It's everyone's. Show 阿乐 first.

steps.narr: Midnight by the lake. The courier rides off, head down, reading the next address.

steps.en: By the lake, under one lamp, the three of you go through twenty years of 假鬼社. 📸

else.en: 阿乐 pins the first photo over the club's door. Nobody says a word. 📸
